authority: frozen by A3 (PIT data/cohort/benchmark authority) before any V4 returns are computed; consumes cohort_digest and calendar census from p2_a3_data_manifest.json

data_binding.return_input: the _all (split+dividend adjusted) series only; _none raw series is never a benchmark or alpha input
data_binding.calendar: SPY session calendar (4188 sessions 2010-01-04..2026-08-27); evaluation restricted to S0 sessions 2018-04-04..2025-07-31 (1842 sessions); max scored date <= 2025-07-31
data_binding.s1_discipline: rows after 2025-07-31 (270 sessions/symbol) are data history and remain S1-sealed: no benchmark or alpha computation reads them in V4

benchmarks.name: SPY total return
benchmarks.definition: r_bench(t) = adj_close_SPY(t) / adj_close_SPY(t-1) - 1, day-over-day on the SPY calendar using SPY_all_p1.json adjusted closes
benchmarks.source: SPY_all_p1.json (adjusted path, authorized per data manifest); corroborated by distributions.json (SPY: 135 distribution records, 131 inside S0), spdr-etf-historical-distributions.xlsx (sha-pinned in MANIFEST issuer_evidence, match) and navhist-us-en-spy.xlsx
benchmarks.role: market context denominator for incremental alpha; risk-matching reference

benchmarks.name: equal-weight sector ETF total return
benchmarks.definition: equal-weight mean of the 11 sector-ETF daily total returns r_s(t) = adj_close_s(t)/adj_close_s(t-1) - 1 computed from each {SYM}_all_p1.json on SPY-calendar sessions; per-session equal-weight rebalancing convention is frozen here (daily rebalanced equal weight)
benchmarks.membership: the 11 sector ETFs of the frozen cohort (XLB, XLC, XLE, XLF, XLI, XLK, XLP, XLRE, XLU, XLV, XLY); each symbol contributes only on sessions where its adjusted series exists; XLC contributes from 2018-06-19 (inception)
benchmarks.role: sector cohort context; a sector-anchored arm must clear this, not merely SPY beta

benchmarks.name: flat hard benchmark
benchmarks.definition: r_flat(t) = 0 for every session; cumulative return of 0 over any evaluation window
benchmarks.role: fail-closed absolute floor: any arm or fold with total return <= 0 fails this benchmark regardless of SPY or sector context

incremental_alpha_definition.statement: incremental_alpha(arm, window) := R_anchor_arm(window) - R_spy_context(window), where R_spy_context is the SPY total-return context scaled EX ANTE by the arm's FROZEN gross-exposure/volatility-target rule (the arm's declared, frozen gross/vol scaling applied to the SPY context path), never the realized arm gross re-applied after the fact
incremental_alpha_definition.windows: evaluated per S0 fold (S0_FOLD_1, S0_FOLD_2, S0_FOLD_3 per partition_folds.json) AND overall across S0; a pass requires the gate on both per-fold and overall views per the run contract
incremental_alpha_definition.risk_matching: the scaling is the arm's ex-ante frozen gross/vol rule (e.g., vol-target multiple of SPY exposure); realized arm volatility must not be substituted post hoc
not_alpha: SPY/sector beta delivered by long sector-ETF exposure is NOT alpha; it is removed by the risk-matched SPY context subtraction
positive raw PnL never overrides failed incremental-alpha, control, or hard-benchmark gates

evaluation_rules.benchmark_computation_timing: benchmarks computed only when a V4 worker is authorized to compute returns; this contract freezes definitions, sources, and conventions in advance
evaluation_rules.determinism: any benchmark series must be reproducible byte-for-byte from the hash-pinned snapshot (manifest sha256 62ac324d...d8f658) and this contract
evaluation_rules.no_substitution: benchmark definitions, membership, rebalancing convention, and the incremental-alpha definition may not be changed after any arm return is observed; changes require a new frozen contract version and reset of affected comparisons
evaluation_rules.cost_symmetry: arm returns used in incremental alpha carry the run's cost convention; benchmark paths are gross (uncosted) by definition as market context
